name: pet-next
description: 单宠物、单屏的透明置顶桌宠。

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-reporter spec core/playback/*.test.ts core/interaction/*.test.ts adapters/media/*.test.ts adapters/window/*.test.ts app/*.test.ts tests/boundaries.test.ts tests/cleanup.test.ts tests/support/process-tree.test.ts tests/support/process-table.test.ts tests/support/run-record.test.ts tests/support/record-cli.test.ts
scripts.test:cleanup: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-reporter spec tests/cleanup.test.ts tests/support/process-tree.test.ts tests/support/process-table.test.ts tests/support/run-record.test.ts tests/support/record-cli.test.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
